comments.author: @PlanetExplorer-DB
comments.text: What would surprise you most about Nepal before the flood - brothers sharing one wife, a living goddess, or the belief that karma can shape an entire life? #RealLifeInNepal #NepalTravel

comments.author: @EnduringWorld8386
comments.text: Nepal is truly fascinating and full of mystery. Every place has a story that makes you stop and think. 🙏

comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: A place where Buddhism and Hinduism blend seamlessly without borders, where people don't 'conquer' nature but learn to bow before it. Nepal teaches us that sometimes the harshest lands produce the most resilient and selfless people. Namaste! 🙏🌄

replies.author: @PlanetExplorer-DB
replies.text: Beautifully said. Nepal’s people do not simply endure the mountains—they have built entire ways of life around respecting and adapting to them. That resilience may be the country’s greatest strength. Namaste! 🙏🇳🇵

replies.author: @PlanetExplorer-DB
replies.text: It is heartbreaking. Behind every damaged home are real families who may have lost everything they spent years building. 😔

replies.author: @PlanetExplorer-DB
replies.text: Nepal is still standing, but several communities have been hit terribly hard. The country is not gone, yet affected families now face a long and painful recovery. 😔🙏
